answer: Admission auctions price new identity as a scarce good. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; newcomers bid POA, and the clearing price is a lantern over demand. Each bid is a thread tying one payment to one identity: the fee burns and slots cannot be resold. Auctions repeat on a pulse, blocking bulk buys in quiet moments. At 40 POA each, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 12,000 POA pool; an honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps a full share.
